code.description: A current TOTP code (6 digits) or an unused backup code

200.description: The session cookie is set and its expiry returned

description:
Checks the TOTP or backup code against the challenge cookie of POST /tokens and sets the session cookie (valid 1 hour). Without a valid challenge cookie (it lasts 3 minutes and works once) the answer is 401. Failed requests count toward the same limit as POST /tokens.

Needs: nothing (public, with the challenge cookie of a password sign-in)
